svg.title: Evaluation and promotion loop
svg.desc: Versioned held-out tasks run against a simpler baseline and a candidate. Deterministic aggregation checks configured gates. Passing evidence supports scoped promotion; failures are retained and cause hold, rollback, or quarantine.
